instruction: Design the main gameplay screen (a single page) for a Crossy Road-style road-crossing game. Include a charming animal player, several horizontal terrain lanes, moving cars or trucks, a river or grass safety strip, score and best-score HUD, and compact four-direction controls. Use perspective and scale to make the crossing route immediately legible. Put strong emphasis on playful low-poly character, clear hazards, depth, color rhythm, and a polished game-ready composition.
